_doc: Runner canary config, read by .github/workflows/runner-canary.yml (budget gate), scripts/runner_canary_mirror.py and scripts/runner_canary_report.py. Decision record: docs/decisions/ADR-NEW-runner-canary.md. Each vendor runs ONLY in its target_repo, which must be source_repository or mirror_repository; the workflow's owner allowlist is the set of those owners. Free tiers were read from each vendor's pricing page on Tue 29 Sep 2026; re-read them before trusting a figure a month later.
remote_url_templates_note: Every accepted spelling of a target's git remote URL; the first is the URL the mirror push builds. scripts/runner_canary_mirror.py accepts an origin only in one of these spellings, and refuses any url rewrite rule that would change the URL it contacts.
pytest_step_name: Run fast pytest lane shard (full suite + coverage live in Full CI, on-demand)

ubicloud.label: ubicloud-standard-2
ubicloud.target_note: Ubicloud's managed runners install on organizations only, so it runs in the canary org's mirror
ubicloud.free_tier_note: $2.50 monthly credit, read as 1,250 minutes of ubicloud-standard-2; the research note that set this also quotes $0.00125/min (2,000 minutes), so 1,250 is the lower, safer reading until a round-0 invoice settles it; a card is required on file

avrea.label: avrea-ubuntu-latest-2-vcpu
avrea.target_note: Avrea requires its app to be installed on the configured source repository
avrea.free_tier_note: 3,000 free minutes a month counted at 2 vCPU; bigger runners consume proportionally

tenki.label: tenki-standard-small-2c-4g
tenki.target_note: Tenki requires its app to be installed on the configured source repository
tenki.size_note: 2 vCPU / 4 GB: Starter workspaces are capped at 2 vCPU / 4 GB without a payment method on file. 2 vCPU also matches Avrea and Blacksmith.
tenki.free_tier_note: $10 monthly credit, about 2,500 minutes at the 2-core $0.004/min rate

blacksmith.label: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404
blacksmith.target_note: Blacksmith supports organizations only, so it runs in the canary org's mirror
blacksmith.free_tier_note: 3,000 x64 2 vCPU minutes a month; GitHub organizations only, no personal repositories

vendor_skips_external_fixtures_note: True while .github/workflows/runner-canary.yml sets MDT_ALLOW_MISSING_FIXTURES=1 on the vendor shards (round 1, Thu 1 Oct 2026): a vendor VM never receives the external fixture host, so it skips tests the self-hosted pair runs. scripts/runner_canary_report.py then caps every vendor at UNKNOWN, never PASS, until executed and skipped counts are compared (Sol P1 on 0e7388c6f). tests/scripts/test_runner_canary_workflow.py pins this flag to the workflow env.
